outcome: content validity of maternal level of care classification
odds of birth at maternal level III or IV hospitals
odds of birth at large hospitals
odds of birth at teaching hospitals
cohort: The study analyzed birth hospitalizations from five US states (Delaware, Florida, Kentucky, Maryland, and Washington) during 2016 and 2017.
finding: The American Hospital Association Database classification for maternal level of care was found to be a valid tool for research, as women with high Obstetric Comorbidity Index scores and those with hospital-to-hospital transfers had increased odds of giving birth at higher-level, larger, and teaching hospitals.
